rationale: TranscriptTools: every upstream property maps to a Go field (types reviewed against the upstream declaration); production and tests attributed by go/types.

anchorsAdditions.rationale: The upstream property anchorsAdditions is the Go field TranscriptTools.AnchorsAdditions.

requestTools.rationale: The upstream property requestTools is the Go field TranscriptTools.RequestTools.
